name: Field-assisted fabrication cell
operation: 24 power plus ≥10 stable useful process-field units and cooling for accepted precision parts. Starter reference/emitter can supply this contract.
mechanism: load blank into centered recess, clamp, expose with dark optics, release accepted workpiece; fixed sealed housing
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for PHIELDWORKS. True transparent RGBA background; opaque solid machinery interiors. No ground, cast shadow, matte, haze, checkerboard, labels, borders or text. Fixed orthographic oblique game camera looking down 45 degrees; weathered charcoal steel, ivory ceramic panels, copper mechanisms. Upper-left lighting stays fixed in world across directions. Clear chunky silhouette readable at 48 px. All sprites fully contained with generous transparent gutters. Exactly FOUR ROWS, each a distinct physical quarter-turn of the SAME equipment: front-left, front-right, rear-right, rear-left. Each row keeps direction, camera, scale, foundation center and fixed service connectors exactly constant across every column. Redraw opposite sides, never mirror lighting. Columns 1-4 = intact powered OFF (dark screen/lamps), light damage (scratches and a dent), severe damage (broken panel exposing internals, still operational), destroyed static collapsed wreck inside same footprint. Remaining columns are consecutive INTACT operation frames: keep chassis perfectly locked, change ONLY named moving mechanism. Do not bake smoke, flames, beams, muzzle flashes, UI or status lights into any frame. Damage during operation will use separately clipped damage treatment; no extra power/status combinations. Output a wide high-resolution sheet with equal square cells.
Equipment Field-assisted fabrication cell: Compact enclosed precision tool with two sloping ivory optical windows, flat sealed steel roof, central tooling recess and round workpiece carrier; preserve reference chassis.. Function 24 power plus ≥10 stable useful process-field units and cooling for accepted precision parts. Starter reference/emitter can supply this contract.. Mechanism load blank into centered recess, clamp, expose with dark optics, release accepted workpiece; fixed sealed housing. EXACT 8 columns x FOUR rows. 4 operation frames at end of each row; if zero then ONLY four condition columns. Leave 15% cell margins and a wide transparent outer border. ALL lamps black. Rows rotate machine 90 degrees around vertical axis: front faces bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left. Last two rows expose closed rear service housing, not duplicated front controls. Machinery stays opaque; background alpha ZERO.
